headlines.headline: NBA champion Michael Malone takes over at North Carolina as eligibility chaos continues
headlines.detail: Malone held his first preseason press conference leading UNC's program as fifth-year eligibility rulings add roster uncertainty across the sport.

headlines.headline: Clippers stripped of five first-round picks, Ballmer fined $30 million in Kawhi Leonard cap probe
headlines.detail: The NBA concluded its salary-cap circumvention investigation into an alleged no-show sponsorship deal tied to Kawhi Leonard.

headlines.headline: All 32 teams set 53-man rosters as league heads into Week 1
headlines.detail: Cutdown day wrapped league-wide ahead of the Sept. 9 regular-season opener; Kirk Cousins named Raiders' Week 1 starter.

headlines.headline: College football kicks off: Coach Prime's Colorado visits Georgia Tech in Week 1 opener
headlines.detail: Also playing tonight: No. 7 Miami at Stanford and Fresno State at No. 14 USC.
